title: [macOS] -Wc99-designator warning on non-Apple/system `clang` 20
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on master (60aae6d856)

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (60aae6d85) - macOS Sequoia (15.4.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads)

### Issue description

Warnings as error prevent building Godot on macOS when using a version of LLVM distinct from the system one from Apple.

Here's a system version of Clang that works and builds well the engine.
```
❯ clang --version
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.0.13.3)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.4.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin
```

Here's the version that fails to build the engine (installed using `brew`) ~~(note that this version is 3 major versions ahead of the system version)~~ (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/105933#issuecomment-2840897350):
```
❯ clang --version
Homebrew clang version 20.1.3
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.4.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /opt/homebrew/Cellar/llvm/20.1.3/bin
Configuration file: /opt/homebrew/etc/clang/arm64-apple-darwin24.cfg
```

```
drivers/metal/pixel_formats.mm:575:41: error: mixture of designated and non-designated initializers in the same initializer list is a C99 extension [-Werror,-Wc99-designator]
  575 |         _mtl_pixel_format_descs[p_pix_fmt] = { .mtlPixelFormat = p_pix_fmt, DataFormat::DATA_FORMAT_MAX, p_fmt_caps, p_view_class, p_pix_fmt_linear, p_name };
      |                                                ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/metal/pixel_formats.mm:575:70: note: first non-designated initializer is here
  575 |         _mtl_pixel_format_descs[p_pix_fmt] = { .mtlPixelFormat = p_pix_fmt, DataFormat::DATA_FORMAT_MAX, p_fmt_caps, p_view_class, p_pix_fmt_linear, p_name };
      |                                                                             ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/metal/pixel_formats.mm:775:42: error: mixture of designated and non-designated initializers in the same initializer list is a C99 extension [-Werror,-Wc99-designator]
  775 |         _mtl_vertex_format_descs[mtlVtxFmt] = { .mtlVertexFormat = mtlVtxFmt, RD::DATA_FORMAT_MAX, vtxCap, MTLViewClass::None, MTLPixelFormatInvalid, name };
      |                                                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/metal/pixel_formats.mm:775:72: note: first non-designated initializer is here
  775 |         _mtl_vertex_format_descs[mtlVtxFmt] = { .mtlVertexFormat = mtlVtxFmt, RD::DATA_FORMAT_MAX, vtxCap, MTLViewClass::None, MTLPixelFormatInvalid, name };
      |                                                                               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
2 errors generated.
drivers/metal/metal_objects.mm:1926:2: error: array designators are a C99 extension [-Werror,-Wc99-designator]
 1926 |         [RD::SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX] = "vert",
      |         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal.mm:3141:3: error: array designators are a C99 extension [-Werror,-Wc99-designator]
 3141 |                 [ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD] = MTLLoadActionLoad,
      |                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal.mm:3147:3: error: array designators are a C99 extension [-Werror,-Wc99-designator]
 3147 |                 [ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE] = MTLStoreActionStore,
      |                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

Here's the related build command that failed:
```
[ 75%] clang++ -o bin/obj/drivers/metal/pixel_formats.macos.editor.dev.arm64.o -c -Wctor-dtor-privacy -Wnon-virtual-dtor -fexceptions -std=c++20 -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -ffp-contract=off -fobjc-arc -isysroot /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk -fcolor-diagnostics -O0 -gdwarf-4 -g3 -Wall -Wextra -Wwrite-strings -Wno-unused-parameter -Wenum-conversion -Wshadow-field-in-constructor -Wshadow-uncaptured-local -Wno-ordered-compare-function-pointers -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Werror -DTOOLS_ENABLED -DDEBUG_ENABLED -DDEV_ENABLED -DENGINE_UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED -DNO_EDITOR_SPLASH -DSTRICT_CHECKS -DACCESSKIT_DYNAMIC -DACCESSKIT_ENABLED -DMACOS_ENABLED -DUNIX_ENABLED -DCOREAUDIO_ENABLED -DCOREMIDI_ENABLED -DGLES3_ENABLED -DMETAL_ENABLED -DRD_ENABLED -DVULKAN_ENABLED -DMINIZIP_ENABLED -DBROTLI_ENABLED -DTHREADS_ENABLED -DCLIPPER2_ENABLED -DZLIB_DEBUG -DZSTD_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY -DVK_USE_PLATFORM_MACOS_MVK -DVK_USE_PLATFORM_METAL_EXT -DGLAD_ENABLED -DEGL_ENABLED -Ithirdparty/accesskit/include -Iplatform/macos -I. -isystem thirdparty/spirv-cross -isystem thirdparty/spirv-cross/include -isystem thirdparty/glad -isystem thirdparty/vulkan -isystem thirdparty/vulkan/include -isystem thirdparty/zstd -isystem thirdparty/zlib -isystem thirdparty/clipper2/include -isystem thirdparty/brotli/include -isystem thirdparty/spirv-cross -isystem thirdparty/angle/include drivers/metal/pixel_formats.mm
```

[See the thread on the Godot Developers Chat for more details.](https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/buildsystem?msg=6CPNCwG4vwmq8q42Y)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install LLVM (`brew install llvm`)
2. Add the installed LLVM to your path
3. Try to build Godot using this new installation
4. See that it fails.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

n/a
